title: CodeChallenge: Tokenize, embed, and cluster happy emojis

cues.en: I'm sure you have seen that ChatGPT uses emojis.
cues.zh: 你一定看過 ChatGPT 使用表情符號。

cues.en: At one point, it started using emojis so often that I had to explicitly instruct it to stop using so many emojis in our chats.
cues.zh: 有一陣子，它用得太頻繁，我還得明確要求它，聊天時不要用那麼多表情符號。

cues.en: So how do language models represent emojis?
cues.zh: 語言模型如何表示表情符號？

cues.en: That is a question that we are going to explore in this code challenge, at least at the stage of embeddings matrices.
cues.zh: 這就是這個程式挑戰要探索的問題，至少先看嵌入矩陣這個階段。

cues.en: I'm also going to use this as an opportunity to give you more familiarity with t-SNE and DBscan, and
cues.zh: 我也會藉此讓你更熟悉 t-SNE 與 DBSCAN，

cues.en: also have a discussion about finding the balance between trusting our intuition versus trusting the results of analyses.
cues.zh: 並討論如何在信任直覺與信任分析結果之間取得平衡。

cues.en: Now, before getting into the exercises, I just want to say a few quick words about how emojis are represented as characters by computers.
cues.zh: 在進入練習之前，先簡單談談電腦如何將表情符號表示成字元。

cues.en: I'm sure you are familiar with Unicode.
cues.zh: 你一定熟悉 Unicode。

cues.en: It is a hexadecimal system of assigning a number to every letter and character and symbol that computers can type.
cues.zh: 這是以十六進位方式，為電腦能輸入的每個字母、字元與符號指派數字的系統。

cues.en: This includes all the keys on your keyboard, but it also includes all the emojis, characters from other languages, and so on.
cues.zh: 它包含鍵盤上的所有按鍵，也包含全部表情符號、其他語言的字元等等。

cues.en: The current version of Unicode has about 150,000 characters in it.
cues.zh: 目前版本的 Unicode 大約有 150,000 個字元。

cues.en: So from the perspective of Unicode, emojis are not special.
cues.zh: 因此，從 Unicode 的角度，表情符號沒有什麼特殊。

cues.en: They are just the visual representations of some character code, just like any other letter.
cues.zh: 就和其他字母一樣，只是某個字元碼的視覺表示。

cues.en: So I want to show you a quick demo in Python.
cues.zh: 我想在 Python 中快速示範。

cues.en: This is not really part of the exercises, and you can actually just watch the video.
cues.zh: 這不真正屬於練習，你可以直接看影片。

cues.en: You don't really need to follow along on your own in code if you don't want to.
cues.zh: 不想跟著寫程式的話，也不一定要自己做。

cues.en: Now that we have tokenized the emojis, we want to start looking at their embeddings.

cues.zh: 但也看到，表情符號由多個 token 表示，所以每個表情符號都有多個嵌入向量。

cues.en: So what we are going to do is calculate cosine similarity between the first emoji in this list and all the other embeddings vectors.
cues.zh: 我們要計算，串列中第一個表情符號，與其他所有嵌入向量之間的餘弦相似度。

cues.en: Now, in previous videos, when we calculated seeded cosine similarity, we always saw that there was
cues.zh: 前幾部影片計算以種子為基準的餘弦相似度時，總會看到

cues.en: Now why do we not see any of that?
cues.zh: 為什麼這裡看不到？

cues.en: Why do we not see that pattern here?
cues.zh: 為什麼這裡沒有那個模式？

cues.en: Why is there no single token with a cosine similarity of one?
cues.zh: 為什麼沒有任何單一 token 的餘弦相似度為 1？

cues.en: Well, what's going on here is that the first emoji is represented by multiple tokens which means multiple embeddings vectors.
cues.zh: 因為第一個表情符號由多個 token 表示，也就是有多個嵌入向量。

cues.en: And as you know from the previous exercise, those multiple embeddings vectors are correlated, but only at around 0.3 or so.
cues.zh: 就像前一個練習看到的，這些嵌入向量有相關，但只有大約 0.3。

cues.en: So what I did here is average over all of the embeddings from the first emoji to use as the seed.
cues.zh: 因此，我在這裡把第一個表情符號的所有嵌入取平均，當作種子。

cues.en: Now is this really valid averaging across the embedding vectors.
cues.zh: 把嵌入向量取平均，真的有效嗎？

cues.en: Well it's not really wrong per se.
cues.zh: 本身並不算錯。

cues.en: But it also means that we are aggregating over some unique features of each of the embeddings vectors.
cues.zh: 但也表示，我們把各個嵌入向量的一些獨特特徵彙整掉了。

cues.en: A better thing to do.
cues.zh: 比較好的做法，

cues.en: A better approach to take is to use the final token, the final embedding.
cues.zh: 是使用最後一個 token、最後一個嵌入，

cues.en: But after it's gone through some of the layers in which the context from previous tokens has been added
cues.zh: 但要等它通過某些層，讓前面 token 的上下文，已經加入

cues.en: to the embeddings for the final token.
cues.zh: 最後一個 token 的嵌入之後。

cues.en: Anyway, we're not going to do that here.

cues.en: We will explore that kind of analysis later on in the course.
